images.heading: Endorsements
images.nearby: Endorsements Please elect Joyce to the school board When Joyce and her family moved to our beautiful city of Alameda she found a welcoming and safe place to raise a family. Her commitment to civic life led her to leadership positions in non-profits and the school district. She served in multiple PTA roles, on the School Site Council, and the Parcel Tax Oversight Committee. She will bring her passion to serving our children, our teachers, and our schools. Write your text here... Tony Daysog, Council Member and City of Alameda Mayoral Candidate Education Endorsements Glenda McDowell, Past Co-President of Alameda Education Association (AEA Teachers Union) Martin Medeiros, Professor of Economics, Chabot College

page.text:
# Endorsements
### Please elect Joyce to the school board
When Joyce and her family moved to our beautiful city of Alameda she found a welcoming and safe place to raise a family. Her commitment to civic life led her to leadership positions in non-profits and the school district. She served in multiple PTA roles, on the School Site Council, and the Parcel Tax Oversight Committee. She will bring her passion to serving our children, our teachers, and our schools.
### Write your text here...
### Tony Daysog, Council Member and City of Alameda Mayoral Candidate
### Education Endorsements
